package scenarionet

import (
	"context"

	syncsender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"GENRE_MODULE/game/rules"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/client/wire"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
)

// Dispatch 是正式 PB → Sender 的边界；actor 只取握手身份，成员权限仍由持锁 handler 检查。
// 房间创建/分配由业务宿主负责；客户端不能借此端点初始化房间或指定其他玩家身份。
func Dispatch(engine *nest.NestMgr) gateway.TCPDispatch {
	sender := syncsender.NewScenarioSender(engine)
	return func(ctx context.Context, session gateway.Session, id, seq uint32, kind wire.PayloadKind, data []byte) (any, error) {
		if id != msgid.MsgScenarioCommand || kind != wire.PayloadProtobuf {
			return nil, gateway.ErrInvalidRequest
		}
		request, err := pb.UnmarshalScenarioCommandRequest(data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result, err := sender.MultiSync_ScenarioCommand(ctx, request.RoomID, session.Principal().PlayerID, rules.Command{Seq: request.Seq, Revision: request.Revision, Kind: request.Kind, Choice: int(request.Choice)})
		response := &pb.ScenarioCommandResponse{Revision: result.Revision, Reward: int32(result.Reward)}
		if err != nil {
			response.Code = 1
		}
		payload, err := pb.MarshalScenarioCommandResponse(response)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &gateway.TCPResponse{MessageID: id, Sequence: seq, Payload: payload}, nil
	}
}
